explication: No password. A code arrives by SMS, and so does your ticket. The same number works on a basic phone with *123#.

code.aide: The code fills in by itself when the SMS arrives. Nobody from AfriMove will ever ask you for it.

mentions: By continuing, you accept the terms of use and the data policy. Your data is never sold.

erreurs.telephone: Enter your 9-digit number, it starts with 6.
erreurs.envoi: The code could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
erreurs.codeIncomplet: Enter the 4 digits of the code you received.
erreurs.codeFaux_one: That code is not right. You have {{count}} try left.
erreurs.codeFaux_other: That code is not right. You have {{count}} tries left.
erreurs.verification: The code could not be verified. Check your connection and try again.
erreurs.tropEssais: Too many tries. Try again in {{delai}}.
